title: Chemistry-to-biology molecular handoff boundary
statement: The chemistry-to-biology boundary passes only a complete source-bound molecular identity, structure and chemical state; biological function is a separately retained downstream relation and cannot select the chemical law.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the eight registered binary coordinates; decide every form by complete carrier preservation, exact equivalence enumeration, minimality and absence of an extra rule.
grammar_boundary: Every finite chemical molecular carrier used by a downstream biological process, with complete composition, structure, state, conditions and separately registered function relation.

choices.name: composition-erased-at-handoff
choices.reason: The object cannot be traced chemically.

choices.name: timeless-molecule
choices.reason: Function acts on physical chemical states.

choices.name: chemical-state-boundary-held
choices.reason: Phase, conformation and conditions are retained.

choices.name: function-as-chemical-identity
choices.reason: Different functions need not change chemical identity.

choices.name: biological-function-separately-held
choices.reason: Function is a downstream relational label.

choices.name: biology-imported-into-chemistry
choices.reason: A downstream law cannot select chemistry.

choices.name: chemistry-to-biology-handoff
choices.reason: Only the complete carrier crosses branches.

choices.name: composition-structure-state-function-trace
choices.reason: Chemical and biological records remain distinct.

choices.name: free-life-criterion
choices.reason: A life label can select any molecule.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Complete molecular identity plus downstream function supplies the boundary.

induction_base: One complete molecule plus one separately held biological relation supplies the first handoff.
induction_step: Appending a chemical distinction extends the molecular record; appending a biological relation leaves chemical identity unchanged unless its structure changes.
exclusions: no stereochemical dictionary, organic reaction taxonomy, polymer table, biomolecular database, measured target or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no atom, bond, orientation, repeat unit, chain or observation distinction may be created, copied or silently erased
absence is an Empty structural form rather than numerical zero
external target content remains inaccessible until the prediction is sealed
Every finite chemical molecular carrier used by a downstream biological process, with complete composition, structure, state, conditions and separately registered function relation.

target_rows.source_locator: authority source set anchored at EBI-CHEBI-STRUCTURE-ROLE

falsification_condition: The claim fails if authority evidence cannot separate chemical molecular identity from biological function at an explicit handoff boundary, or if a tampered row is accepted.
